findings.current: Three jiazi of Scorching Yang Qi transformed into flame. I silently looked down at my hands, wrapped in bluish-white fire, then closed my eyes and reached out.
findings.defect: The draft says the fire has already wrapped around his hands, prematurely completing the encircling action that occurs only after he concentrates and channels his internal energy.
findings.rationale: 깃든 indicates that the flames have manifested in or upon his hands, while the subsequent 완전히 휘감는다 explicitly marks the later point when they completely envelop his hand.
findings.replacement: Three jiazi of Scorching Yang Qi transformed into flame. I silently looked down at my hands, bluish-white flames flickering over them, then closed my eyes and reached out.
findings.source: 삼 갑자의 열양지기가 불꽃으로 화한다. 청백색의 화염이 깃든 두 손을 말없이 내려다보던 나는, 지그시 눈을 감은 채 손을 뻗었다.

findings.current: The flickering flames gradually settled, completely wrapping around my hands.
findings.defect: The draft changes the singular hand into both hands.
findings.rationale: 손 전체 is singular and refers to the hand he has extended.
findings.replacement: The flickering flames gradually settled, completely enveloping my entire hand.
findings.source: 일렁이던 불꽃이 서서히 가라앉으며 손 전체를 완전히 휘감는다.

findings.current: Most of them were at least A-grade, and even a rough estimate put the number at well over five hundred.
findings.defect: The draft changes both the grade distribution and the quantity: A-grade is the baseline rather than merely applying to most of the gems, and 오백여 개 means approximately five hundred, not well over five hundred.
findings.rationale: 기본이 A급 establishes A-grade as the minimum or baseline, while 오백여 개 denotes roughly five hundred.
findings.replacement: Even the lowest grade among them was A, and a rough visual estimate put their number at around five hundred.
findings.source: 그중 기본이 A급 마정석이었고, 눈대중으로 어림잡아 파악만 개수만으로도 무려 오백여 개에 달했다.

findings.current: opening one locked door after another.
findings.defect: The draft adds that the doors were locked, although the source only says they were closed.
findings.rationale: 닫힌 means closed; no lock or unlocking action is stated.
findings.replacement: opening one closed door after another.
findings.source: 복도 이곳저곳을 오가며 닫힌 문을 열어 보던

findings.defect: Refinement disregards the source's explicit 正體 characters, which mean true form or true nature rather than refinement.
findings.rationale: The parenthetical Hanja disambiguates 정체 as 正體, so translating it as refinement changes the named conceptual step.

findings.current: “Look at this undead bastard sneaking a bone-related pun into the conversation. Get lost.”
findings.defect: The draft turns the dialogue into a meta-comment about making a pun. Taekyung is instead accusing the Skeleton King of inserting himself into the exchange, while replacing the spoon in the Korean idiom with a bone for the undead joke.
findings.rationale: 뼈다귀 올리는 것 adapts the idiom of placing one's spoon on the table to join in or claim a share; it is not an explicit statement that someone made a pun.
findings.replacement: “Look at this undead bastard trying to bone in on the conversation. Stay out of it.”
findings.source: “언데드 새끼가 은근슬쩍 뼈다귀 올리는 것 보소. 넌 빠져.”

findings.defect: The exclamation marks are omitted, changing both characters' startled, alarmed silence into neutral silence.
findings.rationale: The source's combined ellipsis and exclamation mark conveys shocked speechlessness and sharpens the threat's comic timing.

findings.current: The Skeleton King, who had demanded his terms with the spirit of an independence activist, became a collaborator and agreed to cooperate. In the end, we reached a dramatic compromise: we would take him to a club.
findings.defect: The draft generalizes 친일파 into an unspecified collaborator, losing the pointed reversal from Korean independence activist to pro-Japanese collaborator.
findings.rationale: 친일파 specifically denotes a pro-Japanese collaborator, and that historical opposition to 독립투사 is the basis of the joke.
findings.replacement: The Skeleton King, who had demanded his terms with the spirit of an independence activist, became a pro-Japanese collaborator and cooperated, and we reached a dramatic compromise by agreeing to take him to a club.
findings.source: 독립투사의 심정으로 제안을 요구했던 스켈레톤 킹은 친일파가 되어 협력했고, 클럽에 데려다주는 것으로 극적인 합의점을 찾았다.

findings.defect: The literal kinship label is unnatural as direct English address and makes an intimate, emotionally charged address sound clinical.
findings.rationale: 외할아버지 identifies a maternal grandfather, but English normally drops the maternal distinction in direct address; the surrounding narration already establishes the relationship.

findings.current: It was spacious in every direction, and incredibly high.
findings.defect: The sentence is awkward in English and adds the unsupported intensifier incredibly.
findings.rationale: The source states that the space is broad on all sides and high, without intensifying the height.
findings.replacement: It was vast in every direction, with a high ceiling.

findings.current: The important thing was the person.
findings.defect: The line is an unnatural Korean-syntax calque and obscures that the decisive issue is whom they can trust to help.
findings.rationale: The following lines enumerate the qualities required of the person they choose, so this preserves the transition in natural English.
findings.replacement: The key was who that person would be.

findings.current: Someone who was favorably disposed toward the unconscious Cheon Taemin and us, and who could continue helping us…
findings.defect: Favorably disposed toward is stiff, essay-like diction that clashes with the brisk internal narration.
findings.rationale: 호의적 means sympathetic or well disposed here; the replacement preserves that meaning in natural contemporary prose.
findings.replacement: Someone sympathetic to both the unconscious Cheon Taemin and us, and able to keep helping us…
findings.source: 그리고 의식불명에 빠진 천태민과 우리에게 호의적이며 계속해서 도움을 줄 수 있는 사람…….

summary: Several physical details, quantities, pragmatic cues, and culturally specific jokes are altered or weakened.
